dedupe_keys.name: norwegian post consumer garment attributes and images 2025

description: This collection characterises 16,464 garments weighing 4,157 kilograms from Norwegian donation and textile-waste streams. Norwegian University of Science and Technology researchers and collection partners inspected clothing from six urban areas in June–August 2025. They recorded garment category, weight, wear, fasteners, other components and care-label fibre information, with a photograph for each sample. Zenodo version 1.1 provides a CSV table, documentation and six large 7z image archives free under CC BY-SA 4.0. The repository archive format differs from the article’s ZIP wording. Coverage reflects the sampled collection schemes, not national clothing purchases. Care-label reliability, missing labels and visual wear judgments are limitations for estimating recoverable fibres or resale potential. Modellers could construct textile sorting and recovery scenarios or material-flow inputs for model-odym. Version 1.1 changes labels and documentation while preserving samples and values. No image archive or garment row was downloaded and no fibre mass balance was checked.
